fromPresets: Or describe it and generate with AI
title: Generate with AI
subtitle: Describe the video. Your AI provider writes the template; LeClap checks it before it opens in the builder.

brief.label: What should the video be?
brief.placeholder: A 30-second launch for a note-taking app. Bold, punchy kinetic type, ends on the download link.
brief.tooShort: Add a few more words so the model knows what to make.
brief.hint: Say who it's for, the tone, and how it ends. One to three sentences is plenty.

examples.launch: 30s product launch for a note-taking app, bold, punchy kinetic type
examples.hook: TikTok hook for a coffee shop, fast cuts, playful
examples.cinematic: Cinematic brand film for a hiking gear company, moody, slow
examples.recap: Year-in-review recap for a design studio, 5 highlights
examples.event: Square promo for a weekend design meetup, date and venue at the end

provider.label: Provider
provider.modelFree: Any model id from your account works.

key.label: {{provider}} API key
key.persistFailed: This browser blocked storage, so the key lasts for this session only.
key.format: This doesn't look like a {{provider}} key (expected {{placeholder}}). You can still try it.
key.privacy: Stored only in this browser; sent only to {{provider}} with your request — never to LeClap, never in a URL, never logged. Usage is billed to your account.

jev.about: Jev picks — it doesn't write. With a Jev key, your brief is classified first (genre, format, energy, best starting template) so the prompt is smaller and more on target.
jev.bestMatchHint: Opens the closest ready-made template ({{title}}). Jev picks it; you write the copy.
jev.bestMatchNone: Analyse the brief to find the closest ready-made template.

status.planReady: Plan ready. Adjust it if you like, then write the template.

result.replaceWarning: This replaces the current draft. Your saved templates are untouched, and Undo brings the draft back.
result.noAdvisories: No art-direction notes from the engine.

errors.auth: {{provider}} rejected the key. Check it was copied in full and is still active.
errors.rate-limit: {{provider}} is rate-limiting this key. Wait a minute, or check your plan's limits.
errors.overloaded: {{provider}} is overloaded right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: Couldn't reach {{provider}}. Check your connection, or whether an extension or network policy blocks the request.
errors.network-jev: Couldn't reach Jev. Jev's API may not accept browser calls from this origin yet — generation still works without it.
errors.refused: The model declined this brief. Try rephrasing it.
errors.truncated: The reply was cut off before the template was complete. Try a shorter brief or fewer scenes.
errors.bad-request: {{provider}} refused the request. Check the model id is available on your account.
errors.bad-response: {{provider}} sent a response LeClap couldn't read. Try again.
errors.invalid: The model couldn't produce a valid template after {{rounds}} attempts. Try a simpler or more specific brief.

plan.planFirstHint: Pitch three concepts and a beat sheet before writing. One extra, quick call.
plan.reviewHint: Pause on the plan so you can edit it. Off: carry straight on.
plan.title: Plan
plan.intro: Edit the copy, verbs or timing, or pick another concept. The template follows this plan.

reference.label: Match a reference
reference.hint: Optional: attach a reference look. Generation then follows its palette and pacing as binding rules.
reference.attached: Style guide attached: the generated template follows this palette and pacing.
